children: Emkay Global Financial' research report on CAMS

CAMS delivered a healthy 2QFY27 performance, with revenue growing ~5% qoq and ~1% above our estimate, while EBITDA at Rs1.90bn increased ~4% qoq despite annual increments during the quarter and beat our/consensus estimates by ~4%/2%. MF AUM-based revenue grew ~4%, with AUM growing 4.5% qoq, while revenue yields dipped marginally. Non-MF revenue grew ~12% sequentially, led by strong growth in CAMS PAY and KRA businesses. Going forward, the management expects no large pricing corrections in the MF business in 2HFY27 and does not expect disproportionate discounting for large renewals due next year. While non-MF business margins have expanded to ~18- 19%, the management targets further expansion to ~25-30% over the next three years, while the company-level margins are expected to see 100-200bps expansion in normal years, driven by productivity gains.

To bake in the 2Q developments, we tweak our estimates, resulting in largely unchanged (-1% to +1%) PAT over FY27-29E. We maintain BUY with an unchanged Sep-27E TP of Rs850, implying FY28E PER of ~34x.
